svg.text: C.6 / P.3 PROTOTYPE REVIEW - PHYSICAL / BENCH QUALIFICATION PENDING
Routed power core preserved. Empty upper antenna region must stay clear of metal.
Power J3 -> main J1: 1=5V, 2=GND, 3=3.3V, 4=3.2V. Keyed pin-to-pin harness.
This is the power FRONT view; mirror X to compare with the main FRONT in the stack.
